name: Aroon breakout
description: Enters when Aroon flags a fresh high/low regime with expanding bands; breakout style.
entry_long: aroon_AroonUp > 90 and aroon_AroonDown < 30 and bbw_value > bbw_value_prev5
entry_short: aroon_AroonDown > 90 and aroon_AroonUp < 30 and bbw_value > bbw_value_prev5

name: EMA trend with ADX filter
description: Rides established trends: price above EMA with ADX confirming strength; exits when price loses the EMA.
entry_long: close crosses above ema_value and adx_value > 22
entry_short: close crosses below ema_value and adx_value > 22
